reply_text:
I can't schedule recurring posts, because I have no scheduling tool in this setup. I can only act when someone messages me.

Bettina, I can still build the digest whenever you ask. Every Monday, ping me here and I'll post "Coastal week ahead" in #coastal-team. It will cover the previous week's items from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items. You're a member of both channels, so you can see everything I'd pull in.

The first one would be Monday, October 19 at 08:00. If you want it automatic, a workspace admin would need to set up a scheduled job for me.
